_comment: Single source of truth for EDK2 query-expansion rules. Loaded by BOTH the Python daemon (edk2-kb/search_engine.py, applied to CJK queries) and the web service (web/server.js, applied to every query). Keep this file authoritative; do not duplicate rules in code.
